requirements.statement: Reject malformed or inconsistent specification records and dependencies
Expose validation, build order, impact, and canonical resolution through the command line
Return a component's declared kind, language, dependencies, requirements, contracts, and data sets from rebuildable generated code
Read an open Triock/verity GitHub issue bearing the verity:ready label and atomically record a versioned local snapshot without executing issue content or claiming remote durability
Commit a ready issue snapshot and awaiting-spec workflow record to its fixed Git branch, resume safely, and acknowledge remote durability only after exact SHA confirmation

contracts.description: The specification model validates records and exposes a component graph to consumers
Query stable component declarations by identifier from the generated catalog
Capture a validated GitHub issue snapshot and its current local pointer by source identity
Persist one issue's input and awaiting-spec state on a confirmed remote Git branch
